scope: Controlled local microbenchmarks, not production latency or capacity estimates. Server remains 512MB.

fill.method: Generated 900x1200 PNG, 5 warmups + 20 loads, upper median milliseconds.

import.method: 64,000 synthetic coordinate pairs in an atomic field; validate plus import, 5 warmups + 20 measured; no disk or network included.

idle_cache.method: 100 documents with 2,000 coordinate pairs each; SQLite :memory:, one sweep and reload. Measures retained handle count, not RSS reduction.

snapshot_cache.method: Repeated serialization of unchanged 289KB snapshot; 5 warmups + 100 measured, upper median. First cache miss still serializes.

transport.method: Same 289KB snapshot; encode and decode base64 JSON vs CBOR, 5 warmups + 100 measured. Uncompressed body sizes. Server Buffer base64 implementation; excludes browser string-loop cost, HTTP, TLS and compression.
